idea-plugin.name: EU Data Residency Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Every cloud region in your infrastructure code, mapped to a country and the transfer basis it needs.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EU Data Residency Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. Offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/eu-data-residency-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/eu-data-residency-lint

action.text: EU Data Residency Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run EU Data Residency Lint on the file in the editor
